passage.text: This weekend, I taught English at a village school in Nan for the first time.
passage.reading: ðɪs ˈwiːkɛnd, aɪ ˈtɔːt ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ət ə ˈvɪlɪdʒ ˈskuːl ɪn ˈnɑːn fər ðə ˈfɜːrst ˈtaɪm.

passage.text: We left Bangkok on Friday night and arrived early on Saturday morning.
passage.reading: wiː ˈlɛft ˈbæŋkɑːk ɑːn ˈfraɪdeɪ ˈnaɪt ənd əˈraɪvd ˈɜːrli ɑːn ˈsætərdeɪ ˈmɔːrnɪŋ.

passage.text: The classroom was small and hot, and the whiteboard was very old.
passage.reading: ðə ˈklæsruːm wʌz ˈsmɔːl ənd ˈhɑːt, ənd ðə ˈwaɪtbɔːrd wʌz ˈvɛri ˈoʊld.

passage.text: But twenty eager faces were waiting for me!
passage.reading: bʌt ˈtwɛnti ˈiːɡər ˈfeɪsɪz wɜːr ˈweɪtɪŋ fər ˈmiː!

passage.text: I was so nervous that I forgot the words of the first song.
passage.reading: aɪ wʌz ˈsoʊ ˈnɜːrvəs ðæt aɪ fərˈɡɑːt ðə ˈwɜːrdz əv ðə ˈfɜːrst ˈsɔːŋ.

passage.text: Then a little girl at the front started singing it, and everyone laughed.
passage.reading: ˈðɛn ə ˈlɪtəl ˈɡɜːrl ət ðə ˈfrʌnt ˈstɑːrtɪd ˈsɪŋɪŋ ɪt, ənd ˈɛvriwʌn ˈlæft.

passage.text: After that, I wasn't nervous any more.
passage.reading: ˈæftər ðæt, aɪ ˈwʌzənt ˈnɜːrvəs ˈɛni ˈmɔːr.

passage.text: We played games, drew pictures on the whiteboard and learned twenty new words.
passage.reading: wiː ˈpleɪd ˈɡeɪmz, ˈdruː ˈpɪktʃərz ɑːn ðə ˈwaɪtbɔːrd ənd ˈlɜːrnd ˈtwɛnti ˈnuː ˈwɜːrdz.

passage.text: The children were so eager to speak that they all talked at the same time.
passage.reading: ðə ˈtʃɪldrən wɜːr ˈsoʊ ˈiːɡər tə ˈspiːk ðæt ðeɪ ˈɔːl ˈtɔːkt ət ðə ˈseɪm ˈtaɪm.

passage.text: On Sunday afternoon, we had to say goodbye.
passage.reading: ɑːn ˈsʌndeɪ ˌæftərˈnuːn, wiː ˈhæd tə ˈseɪ ɡʊdˈbaɪ.

passage.text: The children gave me a card with drawings of my face.
passage.reading: ðə ˈtʃɪldrən ˈɡeɪv miː ə ˈkɑːrd wɪð ˈdrɔːɪŋz əv maɪ ˈfeɪs.

passage.text: I'll never forget their big smiles.
passage.reading: aɪl ˈnɛvər fərˈɡɛt ðɛr ˈbɪɡ ˈsmaɪlz.

passage.text: I can't wait to go back next month.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈkænt ˈweɪt tə ˈɡoʊ ˈbæk ˈnɛkst ˈmʌnθ.
